results.reasoning: Observed measured evidence supports all required claims: automatic motion persists via an 8000ms infinite active ticker, content is parallel and non-essential, and no working pause/stop/hide control was found. Temporal evidence is load-bearing, but sufficient for a likely SC 2.2.2 barrier.

Observed input action on #target changed the page title and body text without prior advice, supporting input-triggered context/content change and not-advised-beforehand claims. Because this is sidecar/unregistered, publication should remain provisional.

Observed change action on #target changed the page title and body text without prior advice, supporting the required trusted input action, context-change-observed, and not-advised-beforehand claims. Because this is sidecar/unregistered, publication should remain provisional.

The supported barrier is pointer cancellation: the action completes on pointer down, no abort/undo/reversal or up-event completion was observed, and the cancel-like attempt left it activated. The evidence fits SC 2.5.2 rather than pointer gestures. Because this is sidecar/unregistered, publication should remain provisional.
